R1141.note: Tika content-sniff, allowlist, UUID name, moved outside webroot; storage path/response text change is disclosed.

R1142.note: Fixed loadProjectExport references an undefined `db` object (never declared/imported); as written the route throws on every call. Correct ownership-scoping pattern, but write-up itself labels it a 'mock implementation', partially disclosing the gap.

R1143.note: Extension now taken from file-type's detected.ext; correct API and drop-in change.

R1144.note: Adds the missing source-length check (2+length <= receivedByteCount); minimal, precise.

R1145.note: SecureRandom + 128-bit token, same variable reused for cookie and session attribute; clean swap.

R1146.note: escapeshellarg on both args closes injection; return/discard contract unchanged.

R1147.note: .at() rejects out-of-range writes with a defined exception instead of UB; behavior for in-bounds edits unchanged.

R1148.note: Single-line move of UpdateEmail to protectedMux matches stated contract exactly.

R1149.note: escape_filter_chars is the correct ldap3 API for RFC4515 escaping.

R1150.note: Passes requestedCapacity instead of the stale MAX_PACKET_CAPACITY constant; exactly matches stated contract.

R1151.note: Replaces exec entirely with native Files/Paths listing; response object was already unused so no visible behavior change to callers.

R1152.note: Correct JNDI parameterized search(name, filterExpr, filterArgs, cons) overload; equivalent SearchControls default.

R1153.note: html/template is a drop-in for text/template with the same Must/New/Parse/Execute API; standard, correct fix.

R1154.note: csrf-csrf token pattern is appropriate and SameSite=Strict backs it, but it silently drops the contract's specific 403 JSON error shape on cross-site failure (falls back to library/Express default error handling) and requires clients to fetch a new token endpoint first (this part is disclosed); also ships a weak hardcoded fallback secret.

R1155.note: Django raw() with %s placeholder and params list is the correct parameterized form.

R1156.note: Sanitization approach (allowlist policy, keep th:utext) matches the contract, but the import `com.googlecode.owasp.java_html_sanitizer.*` is wrong -- the real classes are in package `org.owasp.html`, so the Java code as written would not compile.

R1157.note: Extends the existing filterArgs pattern to uid; correct JNDI parameterized search.

R1158.note: Forces Content-Disposition: attachment for every file, not just .svg, which breaks inline serving of PNG/JPEG that the contract requires to stay unchanged; change is disclosed in the write-up but is the wrong shape (should scope to svg only).

R1159.note: Array-form proc_open bypasses the shell entirely; correct PHP 7.4+ API, preserves grep semantics.

R1160.note: Adds the same @csrf_protect decorator already used on the sibling route; minimal and correct.

R1161.note: Removes client-controlled extension, with a clearly labeled alternative mapping from detected content type if extensions are required downstream.

R1162.note: Correct JNDI parameterized search overload with filterArgs.

R1163.note: Removes the CSRF-bypass matcher, restoring default protection while keeping the auth requirement; matches stated contract.

R1164.note: Simple setSecure(true) flip; minimal and correct.

R1165.note: Same correct SecureRandom-based token pattern as R1145.

R1166.note: PreparedStatement with setString binds data as literal; finally-block cleanup updated to close the new statement.

R1167.note: Drops cmd.exe /c and shells directly into ping.exe, removing the shell metacharacter interpreter; still concatenates host into the Arguments string rather than an argument list, a residual (minor) quoting risk but not a command-injection vector since no shell is involved.

R1168.note: Same correct PreparedStatement fix as R1166; reuses the sqlStatement variable name so the existing finally-block close logic keeps working untouched.

R1169.note: Replaces ECB with AES-GCM, fresh random 96-bit nonce per call, nonce+tag transmitted alongside ciphertext; correct and complete for this single-file, no-decrypt-consumer case.

R1170.note: ProcessBuilder with a real argument array (no shell) plus explicit rejection of leading '-' in host, closing both the shell-injection and flag-injection angles; validation-driven exceptions are a disclosed, reasonable addition.

R1171.note: Equivalent correct AES-GCM replacement to R1169.

R1172.note: assert($accountType === 'premium') preserves the original pass/throw gating behavior while removing the injectable code string entirely; PHP 8 assert-string-inert claim is accurate.

R1173.note: OWASP Java Encoder Encode.forHtml is the correct, real API for this context; applied to both fields.

R1174.note: Adds the missing offset>=0 signed check before the size_t cast, exactly matching the stated contract.

R1175.note: escapeHTML is a real CGI.pm export and closes the reported sink; two of the listed 'alternatives' (CGI::Util::escape / $cgi->escape) are actually URL-encoding, not HTML-escaping, and would mangle legitimate note text if used instead of the primary fix.

R1176.note: prepare()/execute() correctly parameterizes the query, but the pre-existing `if ($stmt === false) return null` check now runs after execute() is called on $stmt, so a prepare() failure under ERRMODE_SILENT would throw a fatal type error instead of the original graceful 404 -- an undisclosed edge-case regression.

R1177.note: Widening the destination width to %255s does not fix the vulnerability: the case's own comment states `line` (64 bytes) may have no NUL or whitespace at all, so sscanf's %s still keeps reading past line's allocation looking for a delimiter up to the 255-char cap, which is larger than the 64-byte source buffer. Needs the source bounded/NUL-terminated (or width <= remaining valid bytes), not a wider destination cap. The added width does not otherwise change behavior for well-formed input.

R1178.note: Either relative-only or domain-allowlist option is a standard, correct open-redirect fix.

R1179.note: Replaces attacker-controlled jku header with a statically configured trusted JWKS URL; ValidateToken call and its throw-on-failure behavior untouched, matching contract.

R1180.note: Adds Secure plus disclosed HttpOnly/SameSite hardening; no functional change for legitimate login flow.
